Subject: topology | ID: 95601

Statement

Consider a Hermitian lattice f: X -> R on a Riemann surface. The variational problem has a solution in the appropriate function space.

Step 3. By the Hilbert-Schmidt spectral theorem, we decompose \(B_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the Hilbert-Schmidt spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through linear approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
